packaging.isolated_installed_workflow: Real background worker in Unicode/space workspace; parallel file edit, wait/output, independent fixed check, three distinct approvals, close and private restore with spawn disabled

development_corrections: A coordinated real-process regression reproduced stderr corrupting a stdout split UTF-8 character when using one decoder. Separate incremental decoders and redactors now preserve each channel before merging.

A paused real cleanup reproduced accepting a new start during reset. Reset now fences new launches and invalidates pre-reset proposals; permanent close cannot reopen the owner. Cleanup ownership is retained if joining fails.
Approval argv is copied before callbacks, protecting foreground and background against mutable input changes.

Fixtures explicitly request UTF-8 on Windows instead of expecting GBK to encode emoji, respect existing command-env redaction, and wait for the scheduled completion notification. Production privacy/approval rules were not weakened.

remote_ci.scope: Owned nonblocking pipes gain explicit stdin EOF for background commands; foreground process runner is retained apart from freezing argv. Windows launch diagnostics use generic command wording.
remote_ci.after_freeze: Verify account restriction and prior exact-SHA gate before another CI-enabled batch; validate native process behavior on required runners.

limits: Background commands have current-user authority and can access outside files/network; this is not a sandbox or side-effect rollback.

Normal scoped close/cancel kills owned process groups/Jobs. Forced host termination, especially POSIX, does not guarantee descendants disappeared; restore never attaches to stale PIDs or restarts commands.
No PTY, interactive stdin, cross-process durable jobs, persistent background output or unlimited runtime. Foreground command-log journal is not used by background captures.
At most four active and eight retained records, at most one MiB redacted body per record; stdout/stderr ordering is observational, not globally chronological. Programs should output UTF-8.
Only displayed tool output fragments may enter optional private history, which is not encrypted. Raw retained body and process handles are not restored.
Completion notifications do not call a model while idle. Further work needs the current active run or explicit user continuation; start and model-requested cancellation need fresh approvals.
Cleanup may have a separate bounded grace/join period. Unknown cleanup blocks new starts and acceptance; ownership is preserved for inspection/retry closing.
Platform skips are not passes. Local Windows/WSL do not replace native CI runners, full Python/client/macOS matrix remains pending.
No external model requests or extra paid account. Protocol/process workflows do not establish new coding performance or parity with top open-source agents.
